findings.evidence: Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/GeneralLinearGroup/Basic.lean:83 defines `generalLinearEquiv`; lines 89–90 already prove `generalLinearEquiv_to_linearMap`, while the standard equivalence inverse laws and `map_pow` give the other three statements directly.

findings.evidence: `IsSemisimplePoint` is defined at line 73 with exactly the right-hand side reproduced at lines 81–85.
